name: Bellhop
description: Bellhop manages a Proxmox homelab over SSH: an inventory of hosts, containers and VMs, provisioning, OS and app updates, NFS mounts, reverse-proxy routes and Authentik access, from a web UI, a CLI and an MCP server.

notes.text: Bellhop reaches every Proxmox host with the container's SSH key. Add /root/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub to /root/.ssh/authorized_keys on one node; in a cluster that file is shared by every node.
The web UI starts with sign-in off. Set up sign-in through Authentik before making it reachable from untrusted networks.
The inventory and settings live in /var/lib/bellhop, outside the application directory. Include it in container backups.
A fresh install has no inventory. Import one with bellhop import-yaml-inventory, then run bellhop sync-inventory --apply.
